identityEvidence.claim: The repo identifies HelpTeachers.net with Homeroom Heroes; official company listing names www.helpteachers.net.

routes.entry: Public root redirects to this page.
observations: Green gradient global header and logo; dark navy page body; chalkboard hero; impact cards; teacher-of-day panel; teacher/donor/random-teacher CTA cards; shared footer.

A stable captured render showed 150+ verified teachers, $9.3k total donations, 135+ schools and Sarah Endsley as Teacher of the Day. Other reloads captured different displayed counts; treat as displayed copy, not verified service data.
Desktop hamburger opens Login; mobile hamburger exposes Home, Donate, Sign Up, About, Contact, Partners, Login.

routes.entry: Global Donate and homepage Find Teachers to Support point here.
observations: Search form has State, County, School District, School selectors and Find Teachers action; Search Results region is blank in captured default state.
Web retrieval had suggested a no-results message; the captured browser screen did not show it. Do not treat stale retrieval as rendered state.
Selector options are progressively populated; only default county/district/school entries appeared before a state selection.
Name/email/phone/password/confirm-password; state/county/district/school; Terms and Conditions button and consent checkbox; Submit and Login controls.
Terms opens scrollable modal titled Terms and Conditions; captured top content has Introduction and Charitable Mission.
No live fields were submitted. State selector exposed 59 entries including placeholder and US states/territories; remaining geography selectors initially exposed only placeholder.
Mission and how-it-works sections, team bios/portraits (six visible people), terms section, shared navigation.
Name, email, subject, message; character counter starts at 250. Typing a local-only 20-character draft changed it to 230. Submit and visible reCAPTCHA area.
Form was not submitted; this is only an in-page counter observation.
Partner sections/logos include Coastal, Microsoft, 100.7 The Wolf, 96.5 Country, Base Camp; Become a Partner/contact path.
Email and password fields, Submit, Forgot Password, Register. Form action is same login page. No values entered and no submit/auth attempt.
Reached through Forgot Password. Public shell captured; no data submitted. Whether reset messages are sent or account state changes is untested and out of scope.

routes.entry: The Forum control exists in the header DOM but is hidden for anonymous visitors. Direct public navigation returned 200.

Search input #post-search-input; Clear; Date (Newest) is initially active; Date (Oldest), Upvotes, + New Post, Load 10 More Discussions. No list form.
Sort controls only reorder cards in page state. Default newest order, oldest order and upvote order are captured.
Anonymous /api/profile/ GET returned 404 and expanded menu showed Login. The public list remains readable.
routes.serviceBoundary: Post list was read-only public GET data; future contents/accuracy and API behavior are outside frontend parity.

observations: Public static source contains form#post-form, title name=title required maxlength=255, body name=content required, Submit New Post button.

Runtime direct navigation ended at /pages/403.html (HTTP navigation response 200 but final URL is 403 page), displaying “You do not have permission to access this page.” Anonymous profile check returned 404.
routes.classification: Anonymous write UI is gated at runtime; authenticated create behavior unobserved. No submit performed.

routes.surface: Public discussion detail, opened from first list card
observations: First list card linked to id=11 (“Forum Styling Guide”). Post GET /forum/get_post and comments GET /forum/comments/11/ returned 200; profile check returned 404.

Visible title/body, vote count 1, upvote/downvote controls, comment form and 0 Comments. Form#comment-form includes required textarea #comment-content name=content placeholder “Share your thoughts…” and Post Comment button.
Vote/comment controls were visible but not activated; comments are listed with public data but no form text was entered. No-ID route shows a missing-ID message.
routes.classification: Public read-only detail observed. Authenticated role behavior and all mutation outcomes unknown.

observations: Expanded desktop menu shows Login; mobile expanded menu exposes the six public pages plus Login. DOM includes hidden Logout, My Page, Forum, Validation controls while anonymous. Their post-auth destination behavior is not observed.
No Privacy link found in inspected public navigation/footer surfaces; site-wide existence unknown.
HTTP 200 PageRouter shell frames `http://127.0.0.1:4188/compiled/hh/index.html` as “Homeroom Heroes compiled project”. Frame 1124×720 desktop and 354×680 mobile.

PageRouter chrome occupies viewport around the smaller framed compiled page; visible controls include Overview, Display & run, Side by side, Functionality, Composition, Delta builds, Scope & evidence, Reload, Full project. Frame renders direct-leaf register state with local journey/devtools controls.
Compiled preview loaded successfully after correcting the document root. Synthetic demo banner, seeded registration fields, local geography and preview controls are visible.
Initial attempt at source-only `/src` preview lacked sibling services import and returned 404; preserved as startup evidence only, not parity evidence.

11 captured steps: register; select synthetic geography; consent; local-only submit; pending; simulate approval; passwordless demo login; create profile; own profile; directory; public profile; reset.
Directory displays two seeded fixture people plus this-tab profile; reset clears sessionStorage. Browser recorded 0 external requests. No production sign-in or service write occurred.

observed: Home hero/tile textures: https://www.helpteachers.net/static/images/homepage/hero_border.jpg and tile_border_1.jpg through tile_border_4.jpg.

Partner logos: Coastal.png (321×157), Microsoft-logo.png (1020×961), 1007TheWolf.png (225×225), 965CountryColor.png (1264×712), BaseCamp.png (385×131), under https://www.helpteachers.net/static/images/partners/.
Google Fonts CSS request and Inter v20 woff2 plus Fraunces v38 woff2 observed. Computed body font-family reports Inter, sans-serif.
Remote Tailwind CDN script and site static/style.css requested. Several hero/card image sources are inline data images; binary payload omitted from inventory.

limits: Screenshots represent pages/states at capture time; browser page retrieval text can diverge or be stale. Browser screenshots supersede earlier text-only claims when they conflict.

Public pages and visible shell states only. Authentication, account-specific routes, backend outcomes, dynamic teacher/donation data correctness, email delivery, payment/provider behavior and CAPTCHA validation are excluded.
No live forms submitted, no login, wishlist, share, donation or contact transactions performed.
No public route to Privacy was found within inspected surfaces; existence elsewhere unknown.
The source-only preview 404 was caused by an incomplete docroot during startup, as shown by missing service module; correctly assembled local comparison uses checkpoint/dist compiled page.

Parity target is the full discoverable public frontend, excluding backend/live services. Current C6 implementation is intentionally narrower. Authenticated role-gated screens remain unobserved. The local demo-login click was not exercised; authenticated fixture state was injected for post-login UI inspection.
Forum public listing and a public discussion detail were captured without authentication. Create-post is denied anonymously; authenticated create/vote/comment/edit/delete behavior remains unobserved.
